relationships.subject: Xiongshao Zhitong granules
relationships.evidence_quote: XSZT inhibited neurogenic inflammation, including downregulating CGRP, TNF-α, IL-1β and IL-18 levels and decreasing the degranulation rate of mast cells.

relationships.subject: Xiongshao Zhitong granules
relationships.evidence_quote: Additionally, XSZT suppressed the expression and activation of TRPV1 and the NLRP3 inflammasome in the trigeminal nucleus caudalis.

relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: In vitro experiments confirmed that activated TRPV1 increased the level of the NLRP3 inflammasome by increasing intracellular calcium levels.
